steps.python:
m = ${made}
import os
assert m['name'] == 'my_task' and m['title'] == 'My task', m
assert os.path.isfile(m['file']) and os.path.isfile(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(m['file']), 'extension.toml')), m
assert m['file'].replace('\\', '/').endswith('/profile/extensions/my_task/my_task.py'), m

t = {x['name']: x for x in ${t0}}
assert list(t) == ['go2_velocity', 'g1_rough', 'my_task'], list(t)
m = t['my_task']
assert m['module'] == 'my_task' and m['env'] == 'nuka_go2' and m['groups'][-1]['key'] == 'goal', m['groups'][-1]
assert [g['key'] for g in m['groups'][:-1]] == [g['key'] for g in t['go2_velocity']['groups']], m['groups']

p = ${made}['file']
s = open(p, encoding='utf-8').read()
line = '        Param("turn", "float", 0.0, -1.0, 1.0, unit="rad/s", help="The yaw rate every robot is asked for"),\n'
assert line in s, s
s = s.replace(line, line + '        Param("side", "float", 0.1, -0.5, 0.5, unit="m/s", help="The sideways speed"),\n')
s = s.replace('[goal["speed"], 0.0, goal["turn"]]', '[goal["speed"], goal["side"], goal["turn"]]')
open(p, 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(s)
import time
time.sleep(1.5)

c = ${c1}
assert c['task'] == 'my_task' and c['config']['goal'] == {'speed': 0.8, 'turn': 0.0, 'side': 0.1}, c['config'].get('goal')

from nuka.train import TASKS, resolve
task = TASKS['my_task']
config, errors = resolve(task, {'goal': {'speed': 1.2}})
env = task.build(config, 'scene.nks', 'run')['config']['env_config']
assert env['fixed_command'] and env['command'] == [1.2, 0.1, 0.0], env['command']

m = ${made2}
assert m['name'] == 'my_task_2' and m['title'] == 'My task 2', m
